notes: A supercar game reads as Racing until you check the finish condition: there is no lap, no track and no finish line here — you drive around a world, earn money and buy more cars — and that boundary puts it in Simulation as a vehicle sim, which also keeps Racing's genre-wide P6 out of a build that has no route to validate. Took Vehicle Sim on world-open, since the answers ask for one small shared city about two to three minutes across, and dropped the preset's resource-shared because nothing is extracted or hauled. path-road-vehicle carries the neon-lit city streets, social-hub carries the garage lobby as the storefront players keep returning to, and settlement-density carries the city grid itself. With no user to ask I decided the garage is an open-fronted showroom on the same surface as the world rather than an enterable interior or a separate lobby map, which keeps this on P0 instead of P3 or P4.
